description: Returns the official text of a disclosure in the EU voluntary standard for SMEs (VSME, B1-B11 and C1-C9) or in the ESRS (2026 edition, for example E1-8 or S1-5), with its EUR-Lex link. ESRS text is available in English, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Polish.

code.description: Disclosure code, for example B3 or E1-8

language.description: The language the person writes in, for labels and headings, for example nl. Defaults to the AI app's locale, else English.

name: explain_disclosure
title: Read an official disclosure text
